mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_llm_invocation ( run_id, invocation_seq, agent_name, step_no, call_kind, streaming, model_name, response_text, tool_call_count, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, finish_reason, status, error_msg, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{runId}, #{invocationSeq}, #{agentName}, #{stepNo}, #{callKind}, #{streaming}, #{modelName}, #{responseText}, #{toolCallCount}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{finishReason}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{durationMs}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_llm_invocation SET status = #{status}, response_text = #{responseText}, tool_call_count = #{toolCallCount}, prompt_tokens = #{promptTokens}, completion_tokens = #{completionTokens}, total_tokens = #{totalTokens}, finish_reason = #{finishReason}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, duration_ms = CASE WHEN started_at IS NULL OR #{finishedAt} IS NULL THEN duration_ms ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, #{finishedAt}) / 1000 END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_agent_llm_invocation WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY invocation_seq ASC, id ASC
